evidence: Description states markedly elevated lipase and amylase with epigastric pain radiating to the back, but no statement that INSPPIRE criteria were met or that a formal AP diagnosis is on record.
Patient is 54 years old; the criterion requires age 3 to 18 years.
Pain is described as 'severe', but no NRS or FLACC score is given.
No information on analgesic use before enrollment; medications list is empty.
Consent is given after the patient applies to the study.
No information on timing of last analgesic dose.
No mention of inflammatory bowel disease.
No mention of GI or other active bleeding.
No mention of gastric or duodenal ulcer disease.
Medications list is empty, but chronic use of these drugs is not explicitly excluded.
No liver failure stated; chronic alcohol use alone does not establish or exclude it.
Guardian consent is determined after application.
Patient's consent to participate is determined after application.
